attributes.text:
Welcome to Augumented lightsaber application. It's one time message. 
Click on hilt icon to select the hilt you would like to use. 
Click on the crystal icon to select the blade color. 
Click the hilt in the middle of the screen to enable the lightsaber. 
Move the phone around to get the better experience. Make sure the volume is up. 
To dismiss the hilt and crystal icons just slide your finger down. To display them again slide your finger up. Sliding your finger down will also dismiss any ad displayed along with the icons. 
 If you encounter problems with sound please restart the application from launcher instead of launching it through the store.
